summary: Example output of the permutations filter on [1,2,3,4,5], listing all full-length orderings.
questions: How do I get all permutations of a list in Ansible?

answer_card.title: Permutations of a list
answer_card.answer_md:
```jinja
{{ [1,2,3,4,5] | ansible.builtin.permutations | list }}
```

Returns every full-length ordering (order matters), e.g. `(1, 2, 3, 4, 5), (1, 2, 3, 5, 4), ...`.
